_comment: img2img stylizer for DJ avatars / hero portraits. Takes any user-uploaded reference at ~/ComfyUI/input/user-portrait.png and re-renders in the MIXHIVE house style (golden rim light, cyberpunk grading, hex-framed crop). Denoise 0.6 keeps recognisable likeness. Runbook will eventually point this at a user-uploaded asset; for v1 the slot is reusable for the founder portrait on the About page.
